scope: Passive acknowledgement of recorded original native return after exact local selected-crew worker ended
defect: An original return could be issued but not acknowledged before its worker ended/timed out. UNRESOLVED retirement then retained the reservation while any original actor survived, even if the issued original return later became positively observable. This is a traced source path, not a reproduced engine failure.
implementation: Read-only VehicleCrewMoveReturnProof requires actual completed original private FSM, matching worker serial/counter/local owner and original episode epoch, unchanged current group epoch and recorded tactical generation where present. No remote done flag, expired timer or changed seat grants proof.

Recorded return entries must match original MOVE baselines and account for every surviving original recipient. Original actors must be local, in the original group/platform and without replacement operating actors. Fresh native observations use the existing VehicleCrewDestinationState predicate; idle/WAIT needs current same-floor position/rest.
An empty original return list needs current idle original actors, retained stop goal and physical rest. All-original-dead measured-rest retirement retains its prior path.

Shared retirement may retire matching metadata after original return proof even if the original window elapsed; it never issues a new native command, starts a worker or renews a deadline for this proof. Live/unproved/foreign/new-epoch work remains reserved.

Active RETURNING uses the same native destination predicate instead of duplicating endpoint/rest/height checks. Original replyUntil is passed; late OWNED observation is not renewed execution permission.

Artillery scoot cleanup recognises the exact matching positive terminal transition. Selected standoff can report completion only with recorded physical HOLD, positive handback and unchanged current mission route; otherwise its old task remains incomplete.

validation.focused: 13 existing artillery cases passed; source contracts follow actual common predicate and passive proof, no new test count.
validation.authorityReview: Final candidate includes current epoch/generation and unchanged mission-route success binding; earlier passing intermediate builds predate those guards and are superseded.

limits: No native/physical audit: actual delayed acknowledgement, original order restoration/travel, empty-return rest, casualties, ownership/repetition/intervention and performance remain unverified; audits paused.

Does not resolve foreign-owner worker termination, arbitrary superseding native orders, deleted platform/journal or missing coherent handover evidence. These remain reserved and need separate implementation.
At most two original actors/recorded return entries are inspected in existing retirement service after worker termination. Added bounded reads are unmeasured;5%median/10%p95 performance not claimed.
Native acknowledgement is command handback, not physical returned travel or whole-controller quiescence/parity.
